review.summary: The original bright shaded 3D style is retained. One shot changes Balls20→19, breaks the upper stack and leaves a readable partial structure with the bottom beam and support intact.
review.game_feel: Readable launch anticipation, energetic upward/outward can motion, short impact accents and a clear settled hold. The full portrait composition remains visible.
fidelity_limits: The generated collision is illustrative rather than a replay of the game physics. Upper side pieces change shape/placement and some tumbling pieces differ from the exact verified inventory.
The lower side clusters, short bottom-center piece, bottom beam and pillar broadly remain in sampled final frames. No win or second shot is shown.
Six encoded samples inspected. Audio stream is present but its spoken content and sound quality were not independently auditioned.
